negative_snippets:
This is as honest i can get :
Hotel itself isnt that bad. Rooms were really good and well maintained. Location is good aswell with the underground parking a little dingy but thats it. restaurant had great food.
What ruined the stay for us was the unprofessionalism of the staff.

I specially called the hotel and asked them to reserve 4 rooms for 2 nights. The rate that was provided was said to be "PER ROOM" as I agree its my mistake aswell that i didnt confirm the rates per nightly, neither was this in written yet what really pissed me off is the attitude of the staff. Lobby manager ANSHU was the one i talked to, when i reached the hotel he greeted me and knew i had the reservation. I asked him the final price and he gave me X amount as the final price. After settling in I had gone down to the lobby and he asked me as to how many nights im staying and I told him 2 nights, absolutely 0 conversation happened after that. At the end of our 2 nights we were told the rate given to us was for 1 night and not 2 and we had to pay for the remaining tariff. I tried to reason with them and even talked to the manager but he simply walked away and didnt even try to talk to me. I believe his name is Manish. This all could've been avoided if the communication was a bit more transparent which is of fault from both sides, mine aswell. But the way it was handled from the staff being extremely unhelpful just ruined the stay for us. I would not recommend staying at this place since I saw more reviews like this. LEARN FROM MY MISTAKE.
